notes: Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022, Science; FBrf0252876), rebuilt from the authors' own per-tissue analyses (flycellatlas.org h5ad) and ArrayExpress (E-MTAB-10519 10x, E-MTAB-10628 Smart-seq2), one project per accession, replacing the old SCEA-based loads (FBlc0003846 / 4307 / 4785, split by sex). Curator decisions 2026-10-07: 10x Stringent per tissue + Smart-seq2 per tissue as complete sets (relaxed, integrated, cross-tissue and 'All' analyses left out); one Cluster per author annotation per tissue analysis. Samples from the ArrayExpress SDRF with curator-reviewed tissue terms (samples *overlap* RO:0002131 the tissue), FBdv stages and stocks from the supplement (only UAS-lamGFP has one: FBst0007378); Smart-seq2 fat body age corrected 3 -> 5 days per the supplement (sdrf_corrections). Mapping (FBbt 2026-10-01) once per author type (252 types, type_mapping/ in li_2022_fca_10x) and copied per cluster: 135 single current author cell terms confirmed by script (22 upgraded to the adult variant), 117 types via reports + map-clusters-to-fbbt subagents. Curator rules 2026-10-08: cell-level terms only (tissue/organ author terms -> cell-level term, else held); no narrowing by dissected tissue. Curator edits (manual_edit, 2026-10-13/14): adult antenna glial cell -> adult PNS glial cell; antimicrobial peptide-producing cell -> antimicrobial peptide-producing plasmatocyte; visceral muscle of the crop -> adult crop circular muscle cell; corpora cardiaca cell -> adult Akh secreting cell; posterior midgut* -> enterocyte of posterior adult midgut epithelium. Types: 175 exact, 65 broad, 1 narrow, 11 held (plus unannotated/artefact/unknown, held). Mapping reviewed by the curator 2026-10-14. No FBbt term requests. Expression (curator 2026-10-14: CPM for all datasets): CPM converted back from the authors' normalised h5ad values, level = mean over expressing cells, extent, filtered extent > 0.2. Genes keyed by symbol, FBgn from the 10x files where given, else by symbol in FlyBase Chado (FB2026_03). All FBbt/FBdv/FBcv terms verified current against the releases listed (2026-10-14). Publication FBrf0252876 resolved from VFB production (pdb). 10x (E-MTAB-10519): 61 Samples, 160 Assays, 17 Clusterings (Stringent per-tissue analyses incl. head and body), 370 Clusters (obs `annotation`; 'unannotated'/'artefact' kept, flagged, held); 336 mapped to 190 distinct FBbt terms. Expression from raw.X (log(counts per 10k + 1) -> CPM): 16,363 genes x 506,660 cells, 573,103 rows; gene ids 16,270 current, 80 secondary, 15 synonym, 1 split dropped (2 merges). Dataset total/filtered gene counts 16,363/12,747. 2026-10-14 (curator decision): clusters with no FBbt term (held) are no longer loaded - listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason, but given no VFBseq id (previously minted ids removed from the registry, never reused), no Cluster entity and no expression rows (their cells still count towards the Dataset's total/filtered gene counts, which measure what the experiment detected); 35 held entries (17 leftover 'unannotated', 4 'artefact', 14 author types with no FBbt term) left out; 335 Clusters loaded; expression 512,215 rows (dataset total/filtered gene counts 16,363 / 12,747, unchanged).
